evidence: Implements consensus script verification and check queue validation for witness version 2 outputs under BIP460.
rationale: Provides the reference consensus validation logic for Cross-Input Signature Aggregation (CISA). The underlying problem—that 'every Taproot key path spend requires an individual 64-byte Schnorr signature, increasing transaction size and fees linearly' and penalizing collaborative transactions—is strategically important to evaluate through review of the consensus verification rules.
